summary: Damen is shipbuilding company, founded in 1927. Type: private company. About 6,116 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 47% of its 17 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about funding; 3 about growth or hiring; 2 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Family-owned Dutch shipbuilder (12,500 staff, €3.2 billion turnover in 2025); 19 roles here, mostly in Gorinchem, and about half need Dutch.

culture.text: An international shipyard group that calls itself a family company at heart; Arnout Damen became CEO in 2020.
Staff often studied at TU Delft, Rotterdam UAS, Avans or HZ, mainly mechanical engineering and naval architecture.
13 of its 19 openings are in Gorinchem, with others in Schiedam and Vlissingen; engineering is the biggest field.
Lists Fellowship, Craftsmanship, Stewardship and Entrepreneurship as core values.

open.text: Concordia Damen Shipbuilding, Damen Services and Damen Civil & Modular Constructions are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Only 53% of its 19 jobs here don't require Dutch, so many need it.

growth.text: Turnover was €3.2 billion in 2025, with 160 ships delivered and a €10.2 billion order backlog.
Has about 12,500 employees across 55 companies worldwide.
Opened a new office in Panama.

worth_knowing.text: Is claiming €4.7 billion from Germany after the cancellation of a delayed frigate order.
Germany calls the claim unfounded, and Damen has objected to the frigate order going to TKMS.
Also faces difficulties with the Belgian-Dutch ASWF frigate programme.
